admission: same finite scalar admission for all semantic programs; compact syntax translates exact primitive Core and then uses the unchanged whole-program patch/source gate; acyclic HIA <=16 blocks and <=128 operations per function; no extra functions/resources; sealed native CPU2s AS256MiB wall5s
cell_order: rotate [hia,assembly,rust] by (task_index+model_index) mod 3 for each listed task
cohort_integrity: exact unique task/stratum/arm/model descriptors and complete boundary identity costs; missing cost is null; cohort rebinds model/source/tools/runtime/registration and recomputes gates from retained cells
context_condition: full two-file workspace in all three arms; JSON HIA and compact HIA have byte-identical canonical starting Core; no query/context advantage
costs: validated input/output token IDs and unknown timeout usage
feedback: one compile/Core-check diagnostic plus three actual public cases, provider observations and expected public values; no manual repair

gates.cross_family: both fixed model families pass the same stratum; no model/task swapping or exclusions after outputs
gates.interpretation: finite descriptive pilot; not population statistical superiority, general language superiority, or complete economic-cost accounting
gates.per_family_per_stratum: all paired cells attempted and complete usage; compact HIA succeeds in both tasks; compact HIA successes >= Rust; compact HIA total tokens <= Rust; submissions <= Rust; complete compilation/public/hidden/identity validation ns <= Rust
gates.representation_contribution: same descriptive gate comparing compact HIA against byte-identical-Core JSON HIA; reported separately from Rust comparison

hidden.feedback: never supplied to inference; execute once after first public pass; hidden failure terminal
hidden.order: one state across tasks; three draws per case; remove duplicate/public cases

information_matching: same mathematical requirement, original program semantics, provider obligations, public cases, hidden oracle, tool access and per-attempt budgets; representation-specific syntax instructions charged in actual token usage
infrastructure_policy: source/model/runtime/tool drift or native infrastructure failure invalidates the observation and halts; no substituted identity or retest-to-pass

models.provenance: official repository metadata captured before inference; different model size from previous 7B trial
same fixed official bytes retained from prior trial; new tasks and protocol

profile_correction: Rust prompt enumerates the actual closed method whitelist; old v3 prompt/observations remain frozen
provider_obligations: the submitted provider must independently return the required value, consumer must invoke it once with original a,b; Rust trusted native wrapper counter and direct native call; HIA actual same-Core VM trace plus separate native entrypoint, not a native HIA counter
request_wall_scope: hard elapsed 180s for the entire generate call, including template/tokenization, request/response I/O and decoder validation; Linux main-thread SIGALRM, no existing timer or blocked signal; socket timeout alone is insufficient
response: strict common files object; HIA JSON function objects; compact HIA and Rust complete source strings; exact filenames/content types only in output grammar; no reference operations/answers supplied
scope_limits: no large project or external caller corpus
complete implicit system-library dependency closure not claimed
previous experiments are immutable and not rescored
compact assembly is deterministic syntax, not an optimizer or safety proof
two task-specific full function files are jointly checked under an explicit immutable manifest
byte length is not token usage
new outcomes do not rescore previous model responses
task_origin: four new finite mathematical maintenance/upgrade tasks and new hidden seed; explicitly follows old negative diagnosis; no unseen project-population claim
timeout_policy: timeout terminates that cell without an extra submission; retain raw partial evidence and unknown output usage; close and identity-check the owned server, start a new owned server before the next distinct cell; no suffix abort from a single transport timeout
